apps.localizedDescription:
Minimalist, fast, tactile espresso logging app designed specifically for specialty coffee dial-in, flat-burr grinders (e.g., Timemore Sculptor 078s), and dual-boiler/profiling setups (e.g., La Marzocco Linea Micra).

Features:
• Log complete pulls in under 15 seconds directly from the counter
• Automatic pre-fill of all parameters from previous cup
• Positive-only grind setting (0.0 to 10.0) with integer 0-point offset field
• Live rest day calculation (pauses calculation when frozen)
• Bag weight and remaining shots tracker based on usual dose
• Full Flow Quality × Sensory Balance extraction insights engine
